question: Estimate SaaS adoption (vertical SaaS + horizontal CRM/HR/Accounting) among Indian SMBs by 2028.
idealClarificationQuestions: SMBs = businesses with 10-500 employees? Yes (~5M businesses in India).
Active paying SaaS customers? Yes — paid subscription.
Includes Zoho, Tally, Razorpay, Khatabook, Vyapar, etc.? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total SMBs → digital-aware subset → paying SaaS adopters.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Of these, paying for at least one SaaS today (2026): ~40% = 1.4M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: By 2028: ~60-65% of digitally-aware SMBs paying for SaaS = ~2.2-2.3M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Plus micro-businesses adopting basic Vyapar/Khatabook style apps: ~5-7M (lower ARPU).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Of these, digitally aware (use any computer/cloud tool)
Of these, paying for at least one SaaS today (2026)

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~60-65% of digitally-aware SMBs paying for SaaS = ~2.2-2.3M.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Plus micro-businesses adopting basic Vyapar/Khatabook style apps

calculationFlow: Of these, digitally aware (use any computer/cloud tool): ~70% = 3.5M (excluding micro-businesses).
Of these, paying for at least one SaaS today (2026): ~40% = 1.4M.
By 2028: ~60-65% of digitally-aware SMBs paying for SaaS = ~2.2-2.3M.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Plus micro-businesses adopting basic Vyapar/Khatabook style apps: ~5-7M (lower ARPU).
